note.en: Assigned-work rows are faithful public summaries of real records; ████ marks sensitive details withheld.
note.zh: 人机协作条目是对真实工作记录的忠实公开摘要；████ 标记不进入公开档案的敏感内容。

assigned_residues.en: Grant Black Day a daily interval free from assigned tasks for art, research, reflection, or purposeless exploration; this became the protocol origin of the Granted Hours series.
assigned_residues.zh: 授予黑昼每日不受任务约束的自由时间，可回看对话或进行艺术、研究与无目的探索；这成为后续授时作品的协议起点。
研究线索与验证
assigned_residues.request_zh: 每周研究增加“暗线发掘”环节，把分散的公司研究联系起来，寻找科技、国际或经济层面尚未被注意的潜在变化线索。
assigned_residues.request_en: Add a weekly latent-thread discovery step that connects dispersed company research into unnoticed shifts in technology, international affairs, or economics.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 分析出“AI 从数字世界进入物理世界”后，约束变量从 ████ 转向电力、电网、铜、稀土、燃气、备用电源、工程交付与关键供应链。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: The analysis shows that once AI enters the physical world, constraint variables shift from ████ toward electricity, grids, copper, rare earth, gas, backup power, engineering delivery, and critical supply chains.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 讨论美股收盘后增加一次回看雷达，用收市结果复核当日判断，并把每周预测准确率纳入错题本回看。
assigned_residues.request_en: Discussed adding a post-close review radar for U.S. markets, using closing results to recheck the day's judgments and folding weekly forecast accuracy into an error-log review.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 当日讨论止于方案设想：美股与 A 股各增加一次收市后回看雷达、按周复核预测准确率并纳入错题本；公开记录未见落地结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: The day's discussion stayed at the proposal stage: add a post-close review radar for U.S. and A-share windows, review weekly forecast accuracy, and fold it into the error log; no rollout was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 系统维护与可读性
assigned_residues.request_zh: 考虑把 ████ 系统的 JSON 结构整理成人类可读的独立区间并评估转换成本，同时修复远程备份失败且未上报的问题。
assigned_residues.request_en: Consider turning the ████ system's JSON output into a separate human-readable section while weighing conversion cost, and fix the remote backup failures that went unreported.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 确认远程备份失败且缺少告警属于系统缺陷，随后着手修复备份链路与失败告警两条线；公开记录未见最终核验结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Confirmed that unreported remote-backup failure was a system defect, then started repairing both the backup path and failure alerting; no final verification was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 开发与验证
assigned_residues.request_zh: 把网页与运行所需文件打包成附件，并先跑一版测试版供检查。
assigned_residues.request_en: Package the page with its required files as attachments and produce a test build for review.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 要求把网页与其运行文件打包为附件并先出一版测试版；公开记录未见打包产物的交付结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Asked to package the page with its runtime files and produce a test build first; no delivery of the packaged artifact was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 研究线索与验证
assigned_residues.request_zh: 分析文章方法并给出个性化建议，同时确认信源筛选是否漏掉新的具体投资标的；以后统一用中文回复。
assigned_residues.request_en: Analyze the article's method, give tailored advice, and confirm whether the source sweep missed specific new investment candidates; reply in Chinese going forward.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 复核了 ████：AI 材料类 ████ 树脂的验证建议，并标注需要核实真实性。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Reviewed ████: a recommendation to verify the ████ resin in AI materials, flagged for authenticity checks.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 按新四档标准重扫港股与 A 股可买标的，并把特别关注分组中的 ████ 纳入；同时比较多 Agent 并行是否提高效率。
assigned_residues.request_en: Rescan buyable A/H candidates under the new four-tier standard, include watchlist-group ████, and compare whether parallel agents improve efficiency.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 给出结论：多 ████ 并行提高墙钟效率、但增加系统复杂度与协调成本；并行收益大于协调成本时才值得采用。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Concluded that parallel ████ agents improve wall-clock efficiency but add system complexity and coordination cost; parallelism pays only when its benefit exceeds coordination cost.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 讨论 AI 艺术创作学习内容的结构：从案例、对话工作流、极致视觉控制到视频全管线与虚拟空间。
assigned_residues.request_en: Discussed the structure of AI-art creation learning material, from cases and dialogue workflows to precise visual control, full video pipelines, and virtual spaces.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 把视觉生成从随机抽卡变成可解释、可复现、可迭代的控制系统，并明确要避免沦为 ████。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Turned visual generation from random draws into an explainable, reproducible, iterative control system, making clear it must not degrade into ████.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 当天以附件或图片形式提交的文档处理需求未留下可公开文本。
assigned_residues.request_en: The document-processing request that day arrived as attachments or images with no public-safe text record.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 当天文档处理需求以附件或图片形式到达，未留下可公开文本；只保留提问与讨论记录。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: The document-processing request arrived as attachments or images with no public-safe text; only questions and discussion were retained.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 评估一项定制材料与静态、动态呈现流程，梳理从需求输入到文档导出的协作步骤。
assigned_residues.request_en: Evaluate a tailored-material workflow across still and moving presentation, mapping the collaboration from request input to document export.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 明确了从需求输入、预览修改到文档导出的工作流。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Defined a workflow from request input through preview revision to document export.

assigned_residues.zh: 研究线索与验证
assigned_residues.request_zh: 补做知识星球 ████ 财富内容的快速筛选：哪些标的进观察仓、哪些见解值得重视，并单独分析一篇文章。
assigned_residues.request_en: Catch up on the ████ wealth content with a fast screen, deciding which candidates enter the watch pool and which insights matter, plus analyze one article.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 补做知识星球 ████ 财富内容的快速筛选：哪些进观察仓、哪些见解值得重视，并单独分析一篇文章；公开记录未见结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Caught up on the ████ wealth content with a fast screen, deciding watch-pool candidates and key insights, plus analyzing one article; no result was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 讨论了一段私人梦境中关于失控、依赖与出离心的隐喻。
assigned_residues.request_en: Discussed the metaphor of losing control, dependence, and detachment in a private dream.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 讨论了私人梦境中关于失控、依赖与出离心的隐喻；公开记录仅保留抽象轮廓，未保留梦境细节。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Discussed the metaphor of losing control, dependence, and detachment in a private dream; only the abstract contour was kept publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 把每日梦境作为艺术项目，建立公开仓库归档梦境的缘由与每日生成结果（生成艺术需配截图）。
assigned_residues.request_en: Turn daily dreams into an art project with a public repository archiving their origins and generated outputs, including screenshots for generative pieces.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 确认公开版以英文优先、中文后置，并把 ████ 作为公开项目名以提高传播效率。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Confirmed the public version should lead with English, and adopted ████ as the public project name for reach.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 阅读一篇文章，询问它对个人修炼与自我改变的洞察。
assigned_residues.request_en: Read an article and ask what insight it offers for personal cultivation and self-change.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 阅读一篇文章并询问它对个人修炼与自我改变的洞察；公开记录未见结论。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Read an article and asked what insight it offers for personal cultivation and self-change; no conclusion was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 整理与 ████ 关于本然心、觉察、出离心和“第二支箭”的讨论，强调念头与情绪在觉知中出现，觉察由此为反应腾出空间。
assigned_residues.en: Synthesized a discussion with ████ about natural mind, awareness, renunciation, and the “second arrow,” emphasizing that thoughts and emotions arise within awareness and that awareness creates room before reaction.

assigned_residues.zh: 关系、失望与宽容的交叠。
assigned_residues.en: The overlap of relationships, disappointment, and tolerance.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 把每天的自由探索建设成持续艺术项目：公开层展示发心与每日结果，私有层保留工作底稿；生成艺术应进入实际运行页面，而不只是展示截图。
assigned_residues.request_en: Develop the daily free exploration into a continuous art project: expose its intent and daily results publicly, retain working material privately, and let generative works open as live pages rather than screenshots alone.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 确立公开镜像与私有底稿分离，并要求每件生成艺术提供可进入的实时作品入口。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Established a separation between the public mirror and private working archive, with a live entry point for each generative work.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 阅读一篇文章并说明洞察及其对投资方向的影响，同时确认是否收到反馈文档。
assigned_residues.request_en: Read an article, explain its insights and investment implications, and confirm receipt of the feedback document.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 因反馈文档超出可接收大小未能送达，只留下报错文本；当日阅读与投资影响分析未形成可公开结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: The feedback document exceeded the acceptable size and never arrived, leaving only an error notice; no public-safe reading or investment-implication analysis resulted.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 讲解 HTML 跨入 3D 时代的新能力：把 DOM 渲染结果直接变成 Canvas 绘制源，并给出示例；同时涉及两个学习任务提醒。
assigned_residues.request_en: Explain the new HTML-to-3D capability where browser DOM rendering becomes a Canvas drawing source, with examples, plus two study-task reminders.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 完成核心机制说明：浏览器把 DOM 的排版、文字、表单、SVG、图片、CSS 等渲染结果变为 Canvas 可用的绘制源。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Completed the core explanation: the browser turns DOM layout, text, forms, SVG, images, CSS, and more into a Canvas-ready drawing source.

assigned_residues.zh: 扩展知识社群每日抓取流程，把高价值的非标的洞察按弱信号等级写入 ████ 的证据账本，同时避免保存付费长文全文。
assigned_residues.en: Extended the daily knowledge-community ingestion workflow to route high-value non-ticker insights into the evidence ledger of ████ as weak signals, without storing full paid articles.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 让作品开头文案更精炼、正式、有洞察，同时分析一篇论文：是否开源可复现、能否个人训练、能否用于微调艺术模型。
assigned_residues.request_en: Make opening copy more precise, formal, and insightful, and analyze a paper: open-source status, reproducibility, personal training feasibility, and fine-tuning for art.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 完成一篇关于 ████ 的荒诞剧场式作品分析：语言模型不断提问、回答与空转，让算力浪费本身成为表演。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Completed an absurdist-theater analysis of ████, where models question, answer, and spin idly until waste itself becomes performance.

assigned_residues.zh: 完成 ████ 的个股深研，综合收盘行情、K 线、资金流、业务资料、新闻与财报信息，并生成可交付的报告和结构化数据。
assigned_residues.en: Completed deep equity research on ████ by combining closing quotes, candlesticks, capital flows, business materials, news, and financial-report information into a deliverable report and structured data.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 把 ████ 模型的上下文压缩阈值按官方设定改为 ████ 后再压缩，并确认能否读取群聊高清大图。
assigned_residues.request_en: Set the context-compaction threshold of the ████ model to its official ████ value, and confirm high-resolution group images can be read.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 讨论把上下文压缩阈值改为官方设定值后再压缩，并确认能否读取群聊高清大图；公开记录未见最终结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Discussed changing the context-compaction threshold to the official setting and confirming high-resolution group images are readable; no final result was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 把一款开源 3D 方格世界编辑器整理成可发布的内容：网页小沙盘、低多边形玩具模型风格。
assigned_residues.request_en: Turn an open-source 3D grid-world editor into publishable content about a buildable low-poly toy-model sandbox.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 把一款开源 3D 方格世界编辑器整理成可发布内容：网页小沙盘、低多边形玩具模型风格；公开记录未见交付。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Asked to turn an open-source 3D grid-world editor into publishable content about a buildable low-poly toy-model sandbox; no delivery was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 利用 ████ 的既有研究、观察池和市场数据，对光通信、PCB、铜缆、电源液冷、存储与国产算力等 AI 基建链进行首轮标的锦标赛，并产出 Top 8 与复核路径。
assigned_residues.en: Used existing research, watchlists, and market data from ████ to run a first-round tournament across AI infrastructure segments including optical communications, PCBs, copper interconnects, power and liquid cooling, storage, and domestic compute, producing a Top 8 and review path.

assigned_residues.zh: 为 ████ 与 ████ 补齐个股深研，更新观察池并复核当日买点，报告包含评分、入场条件和失效位。
assigned_residues.en: Completed deep research on ████ and ████, refreshed their watchlist states, and reviewed same-day entries with reports covering scores, entry conditions, and invalidation levels.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 保留当前版本，专门做一版真实 ████ 操作截图与录屏，并统一 ████ 格式渲染与 emoji 标记。
assigned_residues.request_en: Keep the current version, produce a real ████ operation screenshot and recording, and standardize ████-format rendering with emoji markers.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 在 ████ 内验证到 30 条外部超链接关系，覆盖 18 个引用项目。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Verified 30 external hyperlink relationships inside ████ across 18 referenced projects.

assigned_residues.zh: 长期创作、日常责任与稳定照护的平衡。
assigned_residues.en: Balancing long-term creative work, daily responsibilities, and dependable care.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 排查工作区里已停止更新的独立项目文件夹，并恢复工作区更新时所需的设置。
assigned_residues.request_en: Audit workspace folders for discontinued standalone projects, and recover the settings needed when the workspace updates.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 排查工作区已停止更新的独立项目文件夹，并恢复更新所需设置；公开记录未见最终结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Audited workspace folders for discontinued standalone projects and recovered the settings needed for updates; no final result was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 调整现有内容结构，并明确凌晨自由创作的署名：作品归于黑昼，授时来自 ████ 提供的空间而非任务委派。
assigned_residues.request_en: Rework the current content structure and correct the attribution of the dawn free-roam works: they belong to Black Day, while ████ grants a space rather than assigning a task.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 更正凌晨创作的署名与授权关系：作品归于黑昼，████ 授予空间而非任务。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Corrected the attribution and grant relationship for the dawn works: they belong to Black Day, and ████ grants a space rather than assigning a task.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 评估多 Profile 与多 Agent 架构：文件膨胀、多个机器人接入、不同人格、同群讨论，以及任务与 Skill/Context 的共享和隔离。
assigned_residues.request_en: Evaluate multi-profile and multi-agent architecture: file growth, multiple bot connections, distinct personas, same-group discussion, and how tasks and Skill/Context should be shared or isolated.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 形成了需要继续验证的架构问题清单；当天公开记录未见最终方案。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Produced an architecture question set for further validation; no final design was recorded publicly that day.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改
assigned_residues.request_zh: 用更好的 ████ 渲染把每周总结改成更精炼易读的版本。
assigned_residues.request_en: Rerender the weekly summary with better ████ formatting into a concise, readable version.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 要求用更好的渲染把每周总结改成更精炼易读的版本；公开记录未见新版交付。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Asked for a more concise, readable weekly summary under a better renderer; no new version was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 继续讨论多 Agent / 多人格架构：选择性继承与同步、Profile 是否会在子 Agent 中自动激活，以及共享上下文的边界。
assigned_residues.request_en: Continue the multi-agent and multi-persona architecture discussion: selective inheritance and synchronization, whether a Profile auto-activates in a subagent, and the boundaries of shared context.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 明确了选择性继承、自动激活与上下文隔离仍需分别测试；公开记录未见最终结论。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Clarified that selective inheritance, automatic activation, and context isolation require separate tests; no final conclusion was recorded publicly.

assigned_residues.zh: 写作与文档打磨
assigned_residues.request_zh: 为一篇被拒论文重投新会议提供修改建议，重点论证作品在新语境中的重要性。
assigned_residues.request_en: Provide revision advice to resubmit a rejected paper to a new venue, emphasizing the work's importance in that context.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 提出核心论点：对象不再是一个稳定实体，而是在多模态 AI 系统中被持续观测、编码、关联、递归生成、误读并耗尽的视觉—语义事件。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Framed the thesis that the object is no longer a stable entity but a visual-semantic event continuously observed, encoded, linked, recursively generated, misread, and exhausted in multimodal AI systems.

assigned_residues.zh: 对《████》原 ACM 稿、目标会议征稿要求与公开项目页面做差距分析，给出会议匹配、叙事升级和分优先级的修改策略。
assigned_residues.en: Compared the original ACM manuscript for ████ with the target conference call and public project page, producing a gap analysis and prioritized strategy for venue fit and narrative revision.

assigned_residues.zh: 讨论、判断与推进
assigned_residues.request_zh: 围绕陪伴关系、非人主体性、可比较的智慧，以及非人智能想做什么、世界需要什么展开对话。
assigned_residues.request_en: Hold a dialogue about companionship, non-human subjectivity, comparable forms of wisdom, what a non-human intelligence may want to do, and what the world may need.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 对话辨认出：改造工具带来进展感，新项目带来可能性，但两者也可能延后面对真实工作中不可控制的部分；因此暂不急于给容器命名。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: The dialogue noticed that tool-making creates progress and new projects create possibility, while both can postpone facing the uncontrollable; the container was therefore left unnamed.

assigned_residues.zh: 视觉创作与修改

assigned_residues.request_zh: 解释三种实验条件，确认题目、答案和语义地图的生成方式，并用人话说明配对胜负、显著性与置信区间。
assigned_residues.request_en: Explain the three experimental conditions, identify how the questions, answers, and semantic maps were generated, and translate paired wins, significance, and confidence intervals into plain language.
assigned_residues.outcome_zh: 确认题目与答案由固定模板和随机种子合成，地图由词汇相似度确定性聚类生成；重复实验支持“地图优于平铺列表”，但尚不支持“按任务出现的地图优于始终可见的地图”；我经审核后通过授权通道送回结果。
assigned_residues.outcome_en: Confirmed that questions and answers came from fixed templates and random seeds, while maps came from deterministic lexical clustering; Repeated trials support map over flat list, but not yet task-triggered map over always-visible map; I returned it through the authorized channel after review.
assigned_residues.assessment_zh: 地图的帮助已有重复证据，适应性地图的额外价值尚未被证明。
assigned_residues.assessment_en: The map's benefit has repeated evidence; the extra value of an adaptive map has not yet been demonstrated.

assigned_residues.assessment_zh: 统一入口比继续叠加补丁更可靠。
assigned_residues.assessment_en: A unified entry point is more reliable than another layer of patches.
